name: Chezmoi Hound
author: Nathan
description: A bar count of dotfile drift that hunts it down. It adds up what this machine has edited and the source has not captured, what the source repo has not committed, and what the remote has not seen - then the panel names the items and offers to push them, capture and commit them, apply the source to them, or stop managing them. It also lists the managed files that differ from the Omarchy defaults in /etc/skel.

barWidget.description: Dotfile drift across $HOME, the source repo and its remote, with push, capture-and-commit, apply-the-source and ignore actions.

schema.label: chezmoi source directory
schema.description: Leave empty to use chezmoi's own configured source. Set it when the source is a tree you normally pass to `chezmoi --source`, such as ~/Projects/dotfiles.

schema.label: Defaults to compare against
schema.description: Lists the chezmoi-managed files that differ from the defaults a new account starts from (Omarchy ships them in /etc/skel). Shown in the panel, never added to the count. Leave empty to turn it off.

schema.label: When everything is in sync
schema.description: Hide keeps the bar free of a permanent zero.
